title: To Keep or Not to Keep: Learning KV Cache Retention in Disaggregated LLM Serving Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.28637v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Disaggregated \textsc{LLM} serving separates prefill and decode across node pools, placing a network fabric between \textsc{KV}-cache computation and consumption. This breaks a key assumption of classical cache policies: a miss no longer incurs only local recomputation, but also network transfer to the decode node. Likewise, admitting a block to the global cache requires an additional transfer, so poor retention decisions waste both memory and bandwidth. We present \textbf{KVLearn}, a learning-based framework for cost-aware \textsc{KV}-cache retention in disaggregated serving. KVLearn includes: (i) a lightweight Prefix Reuse Predictor (\textsc{PRP}) that estimates reuse probability from structural and temporal prefix features without modifying model weights; (ii) a Cost-Aware Retention Score (\textsc{CARS}) that converts reuse probability into keep/admit decisions using recomputation, transfer, and storage costs; and (iii) an Adaptive Th

translated_title: 保留还是丢弃：在解耦式LLM服务系统中学习KV缓存保留策略
translated_abstract: 解耦式LLM服务将预填充与解码阶段分离到不同的节点池中，在KV缓存的计算与消费之间引入了网络架构。这打破了经典缓存策略的一个关键假设：缓存未命中不再仅仅导致本地重计算，还需要向解码节点进行网络传输。同样，将一个数据块存入全局缓存也需要额外的传输，因此糟糕的保留决策会同时浪费内存和带宽。我们提出了KVLearn，一个面向解耦式服务中成本感知KV缓存保留的学习型框架。KVLearn包含：(i) 一个轻量级的前缀复用预测器（PRP），它从结构和时间上的前缀特征估计复用概率，而无需修改模型权重；(ii) 一个成本感知保留分数（CARS），它利用重计算、传输和存储成本将复用概率转换为保留/准入决策；(iii) 一个自适应阈值……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 提出了KVLearn框架，通过轻量级前缀复用预测器学习复用概率，并结合重计算、传输和存储成本进行成本感知的KV缓存保留决策，同时节省解耦式LLM服务中的内存与带宽。
